_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Only saying goodbye or relax in a stiff way

segments.text: It means, relax and do not worry.
You work too much. Take it easy!
Repeat after me. Take it easy.

native.hook: A friendly way to say relax
native.caption: Want a friendly way to tell someone to relax? Say “Take it easy.” It also works as a casual goodbye. Example: “You work too much. Take it easy!” Listen to Ama, then say it in the pause. Practice more in the Lexkite app.
